#!/usr/bin/env python3
import sys
from textwrap import dedent

stories = [
    {
        "id": "US-001",
        "title": "Create a note",
        "persona": "End User",
        "action": "create a personal note with a title and body",
        "benefit": "I can capture information quickly",
        "priority": "HIGH",
        "points": 3,
        "ac": [
            "Given the user is on the notes page, When they submit a valid title and body, Then the note is saved and shown in the notes list.",
            "Given the title is empty, When the user submits the form, Then an inline validation message is displayed.",
            "Given the save request fails, When the user submits the form, Then a user-friendly error message is shown.",
            "Given a valid submission, When the note is saved, Then the operation completes within 2 seconds.",
            "Given the form is open, When the user navigates by keyboard only, Then all inputs and the save button are reachable."
        ]
    },
    {
        "id": "US-002",
        "title": "Edit an existing note",
        "persona": "End User",
        "action": "edit an existing personal note",
        "benefit": "I can keep my information accurate",
        "priority": "HIGH",
        "points": 5,
        "ac": [
            "Given an existing note, When the user updates the title or body and saves, Then the updated content is displayed in the notes list.",
            "Given no changes were made, When the user clicks save, Then no duplicate note is created.",
            "Given the note no longer exists, When the user tries to save changes, Then an error message indicates the note could not be updated.",
            "Given the edit form is open, When the user presses cancel, Then the original note remains unchanged.",
            "Given a valid edit, When the user saves, Then the operation completes within 2 seconds."
        ]
    },
    {
        "id": "US-003",
        "title": "Delete a note",
        "persona": "End User",
        "action": "delete a personal note",
        "benefit": "I can remove outdated information",
        "priority": "MEDIUM",
        "points": 3,
        "ac": [
            "Given an existing note, When the user confirms deletion, Then the note is removed from the notes list.",
            "Given the user selects delete, When the confirmation dialog appears, Then they can cancel without deleting the note.",
            "Given the delete request fails, When the user confirms deletion, Then a clear error message is shown.",
            "Given a note is deleted, When the list refreshes, Then the change is reflected within 2 seconds."
        ]
    },
    {
        "id": "US-004",
        "title": "Search notes by keyword",
        "persona": "Power User",
        "action": "search notes by title or body keyword",
        "benefit": "I can find information faster",
        "priority": "HIGH",
        "points": 5,
        "ac": [
            "Given multiple notes exist, When the user enters a keyword, Then only matching notes are displayed.",
            "Given no notes match the keyword, When the search runs, Then an empty-state message is displayed.",
            "Given the search box contains text, When the user clears it, Then the full notes list is shown again.",
            "Given the user types a keyword, When results are returned, Then the search completes within 2 seconds.",
            "Given the notes page is open, When the user tabs to the search box, Then they can perform search using keyboard only."
        ]
    },
    {
        "id": "US-005",
        "title": "Persist notes in local storage",
        "persona": "Developer",
        "action": "store notes in browser local storage",
        "benefit": "the app works without a backend for an MVP",
        "priority": "MEDIUM",
        "points": 3,
        "ac": [
            "Given the user creates or edits a note, When the change is saved, Then the note data is written to local storage.",
            "Given notes are stored locally, When the user refreshes the page, Then the notes are restored correctly.",
            "Given local storage is unavailable, When the app loads, Then the user sees a clear error state."
        ]
    }
]

def print_story(s):
    print(f"USER STORY: {s['id']}")
    print("=" * 40)
    print(f"Title: {s['title']}")
    print("Type: story")
    print(f"Priority: {s['priority']}")
    print(f"Points: {s['points']}\n")
    print("Story:")
    print(f"As a {s['persona']},")
    print(f"I want to {s['action']},")
    print(f"So that {s['benefit']}.\n")
    print("Acceptance Criteria:")
    for i, ac in enumerate(s['ac'], 1):
        print(f"  {i}. {ac}")
    print("\nINVEST Checklist:")
    for item in ["Independent", "Negotiable", "Valuable", "Estimable", "Small", "Testable"]:
        print(f"  ✓ {item}")
    print()


def sprint_plan(avg_velocity):
    availability = 0.9
    capacity = avg_velocity * availability
    committed_cap = int(round(capacity * 0.85))
    stretch_cap = max(1, int(round(capacity - committed_cap)))
    ordered = sorted(stories, key=lambda s: ({"HIGH": 0, "MEDIUM": 1, "LOW": 2}[s['priority']], s['points']))
    committed, stretch = [], []
    committed_points = 0
    stretch_points = 0
    for s in ordered:
        if committed_points + s['points'] <= committed_cap:
            committed.append(s)
            committed_points += s['points']
        elif stretch_points + s['points'] <= stretch_cap:
            stretch.append(s)
            stretch_points += s['points']
    print(f"Sprint Capacity: {capacity:.1f} points")
    print("Sprint Goal: Deliver core note management and search for MVP\n")
    print(f"COMMITTED ({committed_points} points):")
    for s in committed:
        print(f"[{s['priority'][0]}] {s['id']}: {s['title']} ({s['points']} pts)")
    print(f"\nSTRETCH ({stretch_points} points):")
    for s in stretch:
        print(f"[{s['priority'][0]}] {s['id']}: {s['title']} ({s['points']} pts)")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == 'sprint':
        avg = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 25
        sprint_plan(avg)
    else:
        print(dedent("""
        Epic: Personal Notes MVP
        Success Criteria: Users can create, edit, delete, and search notes in a simple browser app.
        """).strip())
        print()
        for s in stories:
            print_story(s)
EOF
